system.description: During Downtime, you can race in the crawler-runs of the Ger or the midnight laps of the Kettlewhistle Fair. Test Agility (DR14). Triumph: win 2d6 × 10 s, and a rival wants a rematch. Success: win d6 × 10 s. Failure: you lose and pay d6 × 10 s in repairs. Ruin: you crash; the rig is wrecked (rebuild it as above) and you begin your next adventure with one wound.
